rules.title: Five in a row. That's it.
rules.subtitle: Three simple rules to get your first game started.
rules.firstText: Place stones on the intersections of a 15 × 15 board. Black starts, then players take turns placing one stone.
rules.placeText: Choose an empty intersection. Once placed, a stone cannot be moved or stacked on another.
rules.winText: Connect five stones of your color horizontally, vertically or diagonally. Longer lines also win.
rules.example: Example: black wins with five stones in a horizontal row
rules.notice: Yijian uses freestyle Gomoku rules with no forbidden moves. A full board without a winning line is a draw.
